narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A square is not a rectangle, because it looks different.
<bookmark mark='check'/>But the square has equal opposite sides, and it has four right angles.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It has everything that a rectangle needs, so it is a rectangle.

<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A slanted shape has four equal sides but no right angles. Is it a square?
